2023 Ford Raptor Hennessey ! Serial #98
VelociRaptor 600: Production for this model has generally been limited to around 250 units per year.
Hennessey Performance offers the VelociRaptor 600 upgrade for the 2023 Ford Raptor, which significantly boosts performance and adds off-road modifications. It increases the output of the stock 3.5L EcoBoost V6 engine from 450 hp to 558 hp and from 510 lb-ft of torque to 672 lb-ft.

Performance and Specs
The Hennessey VelociRaptor 600 package for the 2023 Ford Raptor provides a substantial increase in power and torque through a series of mechanical and software upgrades.
Horsepower: 558 bhp @ 5,100 rpm (up from the stock 450 hp).
Torque: 672 lb-ft @ 3,500 rpm (up from the stock 510 lb-ft).
0-60 mph acceleration: Approximately 4.2 seconds (compared to an estimated 5.3 seconds stock).
Engine Upgrades: Includes an enhanced air induction system, a high-capacity air-to-air front-mounted intercooler with a blow-off valve, and an upgraded engine management computer software tune.

In addition to engine enhancements, the Hennessey VelociRaptor 600 package includes several exterior and suspension modifications to enhance its look and off-road capability.
Bumpers: Custom VelociRaptor front and rear steel bumpers with an integrated front LED light bar.
Wheels and Tires: 20-inch Hennessey wheels with a choice of 35-inch or 37-inch off-road tires.
Suspension: A front suspension leveling kit and a 3-inch overall lift are added.
Other features: Powered electric fold-out steps and Hennessey exterior badging are included. An upgraded front performance Brembo 6-piston brake kit is an optional upgrade.

The Regular Cab version has a two-door configuration with a short bed, making it ideal for light-duty hauling while emphasizing a compact profile suitable for urban driving. Under the hood, the 1993 Splash commonly came with either a 2.3-liter inline-4 engine or an available 4.0-liter V6, offering drivers a blend of fuel efficiency and respectable power for its size. Rear-wheel drive was standard, though some models offered optional four-wheel drive for added versatility.----Inside the cab, the 1993 Ranger Splash offers a simple, driver-focused layout with supportive bucket seats and user-friendly controls. While not overly luxurious, it provides the essential comfort features expected of a vehicle from the early 1990s, including an AM/FM radio, optional air conditioning, and cloth upholstery. The suspension setup ensures a relatively smooth ride for a small pickup, while sporty styling cues such as alloy wheels and unique badging make the Splash trim particularly appealing to younger buyers or enthusiasts looking for a truck with personality. Overall, the 1993 Ford Ranger Splash Regular Cab is a compact and stylish truck that successfully blends utility with sporty flair, making it a memorable option from Ford's early '90s lineup.
